name: Deadeye Fleet
description: A fleet of captains of the Brazen Coalition who once served in the naval forces of the Free Cities and preferred infiltration, assassination and thievery.

description_citations.text: "Wallis Parrish". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Parrish commands the Tide Turner and secures the conditional loyalty of other Deadeye captains.
timeline.quote: Captain Wallis Parrish commanded the Tide Turner

citation.text: "Wallis Parrish", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Parrish keeps the captains loyal by controlling information and handing out tips, in exchange for a share of spoils.
timeline.quote: Captain Parrish kept the other captains loyal to her by controlling the flow of information

citation.text: "Wallis Parrish", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Governor Brass returns the former Deadeyes to the status of a national navy, the Bluecoats.
timeline.quote: the former Deadeyes returned to their old status as a national navy by Governor Brass

citation.text: "Wallis Parrish", section "New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Her flag unites the Deadeye captains.
relations.quote: a handful of other captains who sail under Parrish's flag as part of a fleet called the Deadeyes

citation.text: "Wallis Parrish", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
